title: The Jury is out.
text: I just received my first Allure Beauty Box  and I must say that I am not too impressed so far.  Most of the items are in what I would call a trial size and all present the retail price for a full size and where to get it.  I don’t mind trying something and taking the time to review it for the manufacturer but I don’t particularly like to pay for the privilege.  I will continue my subscription for the Allure Beauty Box for another month to see if I am more impressed the second time around. If not, I will cancel my subscription.  I will update my review at that time.
label: neutral
